notes:
Nova Proxy 5.0.0.

The ECH key resolver now defaults to plain DNS at 1.1.1.1, which is the combination that works from Iran as of October 2026. Panels still set to AliDNS or an empty resolver migrate on load, and the ECH card has a resolver preset.

Raw VLESS and Trojan TLS links can carry a decoy SNI for Nova desktop clients. It is off by default, applies only to the first packet, and is never written into Clash, sing-box, Shadowsocks or plaintext configs.

The panel shows a risk chip for every host, a banner when no custom domain is present, and a new audit card that lists what each config format sends. Resistance Policy gains an Enhanced fragment row and no longer warns about ECH. The dashboard activity list scrolls instead of growing.
